message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 220, "amount_cents": 9480}, {"order_id": 222, "amount_cents": 30660}, {"order_id": 223, "amount_cents": 23129}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: Alpha reported refunds for order_ids 220 (9480), 222 (30660), 223 (23129) but system shows only 220 (9480) and 223 (23129).

reply.thought: I need to verify the refunds in the system match Alpha's reported list before paying any customer, then get net balances and record one payout per customer.
Refunds returned by the system only include orders 220 and 223; Alpha reported an additional refund for order 222 (30660). This mismatch requires a hold before paying.
